title: Salivary DNA Extraction
author: Clemens Scherzer
materials: Carefully pipette off the supernatant and discard it.

steps.title: Prepare and Weigh Saliva Sample
steps.instruction: Mix the sample in the DNA Genotek kit using inversion and gentle shaking, then estimate the saliva volume.

substeps.instruction: Mix sample in the DNA Genotek kit by inversion and gentle shaking.
Weigh the sample in the original tube and subtract 6.81g to estimate the volume of saliva provided.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample to facilitate DNA release using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Incubate in an air incubator at 50 °C for a minimum of 02:00:00.
Option 2: Incubate in a 50 °C water bath for a minimum of 01:00:00 or overnight.

steps.title: Transfer and Volume Recording
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a new tube and record the volume.

substeps.instruction: Pour the entire sample into a 15mL falcon tube.
Note the volume of the sample.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Treat the sample with PT-L2P to precipitate proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/25th volume of PT-L2P and mix by vortexing for a few seconds.
Incubate on ice for 00:10:00.
Centrifuge at 4500 rpm (max speed) for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the supernatant using ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer most of the clear supernatant with a pipette to a fresh 50mL centrifuge tube.
Add 1.2x volume of room temperature 100% ethanol to the supernatant.
Mix gently by inversion 10x.
Let the sample stand at room temperature for 00:10:00 to allow DNA to fully precipitate.
Centrifuge at 4500 rpm (max speed) for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 70% ethanol to the tube without disturbing the pellet.
Let stand at room temperature for 00:01:00.
Gently swirl and completely remove the ethanol without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Rehydrate the DNA pellet using TE solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of TE solution to rehydrate the DNA.
Let stand at room temperature for 00:05:00 to allow remaining ethanol to evaporate.
Incubate at room temperature for 01:00:00 or at 4 °C overnight.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10x using wide-bore pipette tips.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Divide the rehydrated DNA into aliquots and store in freezers.

substeps.instruction: Mix by pipetting up and down 10x using wide-bore pipette tips.
Transfer the rehydrated DNA to two fresh 1.5mL low-retention microcentrifuge tubes (150uL each).
Label aliquots as “DNA-SAL-01” and “DNA-SAL-02”.
Scan DNA samples into the Freezerworks Inventory Program and position in the corresponding freezer.
Separate and store each DNA aliquot (DNA-SAL-01 and DNA-SAL-02) in two different local -80°C freezers.
